summary: All 9 applicable boxes were re-verified together in one Deus Ex MP game on deusex-server (.132:7790, DXMP_Cathedral). The roster named Fleet110/123/124/133/143/171/184/186/240 and every box sent 323-439 pkts in 12 s; each fresh frame shows the map. .243 is NA. The game was closed everywhere and no deusex.exe remains.
issues: .124's deusex.exe ignored the graceful close and was force-killed after 12 s. The box is back at its 1280x1024@85 desktop and the agent answers.

The HUD-less frames the round agent reported for .143/.184 were transient: in the re-check .143 showed its HUD and .184 a partial HUD, while .133 showed no HUD at that instant. Respawn/view timing, not a fault.
Persistent User.ini edits on every box (PageUp bind 'open 192.168.1.132:7790?Name=Fleet<octet>', player name); .186 keeps SoftDrv.
